mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_no, name, email, phone, department_id, position, level, base_salary, hire_date, status, skills, address_province, address_city, address_district, address_detail, created_time, updated_time FROM t_employee WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, employee_no, name, email, phone, department_id, position, level, status, hire_date, created_time FROM t_employee WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_employee (employee_no, name, email, phone, department_id, position, level, base_salary, hire_date, status, skills, address_province, address_city, address_district, address_detail, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{employeeNo}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{departmentId}, #{position}, #{level}, #{baseSalary}, #{hireDate}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), #{skills,jdbcType=VARCHAR,typeHandler=cn.myslayers.libra.module.toolkit.model.handler.ListTypeHandler}, #{address.province}, #{address.city}, #{address.district}, #{address.detailAddress}, NOW(), NOW())

mapper.select: SELECT d.id as department_id, d.name as department_name, COUNT(e.id) as employee_count, AVG(e.base_salary) as avg_salary, MAX(e.base_salary) as max_salary, MIN(e.base_salary) as min_salary FROM t_department d LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON d.id = e.department_id AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY employee_count DESC

AND (
